title: Blender conversion integrity - strict success contract for OBJ->FBX

defect_summary.marker_only_gate: BlenderRunner.run() returned status='ok' if only 'CONVERSION_OK' marker appeared in stdout. Exit code, FBX validity, manifest parse, hash cross-checks, and object count were all ignored.
defect_summary.no_artifact_binding: output_hash recorded but never cross-checked against manifest's output_fbx_hash; input_hash never compared to manifest's input_obj_hash. Provenance sidecar (.fbx.provenance.json) never written.
defect_summary.stale_fbx_risk: Phase J J6 roundtrip ran if fbx_path.exists() && blender exists, even if the current Blender conversion failed - roundtrip could validate a stale FBX from a prior run.
defect_summary.blender_availability: _check_blender ignored --version exit code and accepted any line containing 'Blender' as success. Missing binary returned 'skipped' instead of fail-closed 'blocked'.
defect_summary.missing_verification: No host-side FBX container validation (Kaydara magic), no object-count gate (zero-object exports passed), no input/output hash readability checks.

corrected_semantics.success_gate: status='ok' IFF all of: marker_present AND exit_code==0 AND fbx_present+size>0 AND fbx_container.container_ok (Kaydara magic) AND manifest_parse_ok AND manifest_present AND input_hash_match AND output_hash_match AND objects_nonempty AND input_hash_readable. Any failure -> status='failed' with failed_checks list + stderr tail.
corrected_semantics.blocked_status: Blender binary missing/unverifiable -> status='blocked', reason='Blender not available: ...' (fail-closed external dependency). OBJ input missing/invalid remains 'skipped' (genuine precondition).
corrected_semantics.provenance_sidecar: <prefix>.fbx.provenance.json written on fbx_present with schema v1: input_sha256, artifact_sha256, blender_version, blender_exe_hash, script_hash, exit_code, status, verification bools, generated_at_utc.
corrected_semantics.phase_j_integration: J3_blender_fbx verdict added (PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED). J6 roundtrip gated: runs only if current conversion status in ('ok','skipped') and FBX exists; if conversion failed/blocked -> J6={ok: None, reason='Blender conversion did not succeed; refusing to round-trip possibly stale artifact'}.

coverage.A: success path - all verification checks pass, provenance written
coverage.B: missing CONVERSION_OK marker -> failed with failed_checks
coverage.C: nonzero exit code -> failed even with marker
coverage.G: input hash mismatch (manifest vs host) -> failed
coverage.K: provenance sidecar written on success with schema v1
coverage.N: Blender version check exits non-zero -> blocked
coverage.O: Valid OBJ but no Blender -> blocked (not skipped)

residual_risks: Phase J main() still returns exit code 0 even when J3_FAIL/J6_FAIL present (verdict string is the honest signal; non-zero exit would break existing callers).
Provenance sidecar written only on fbx_present; a failed conversion with no FBX leaves no sidecar (intentional - no artifact to bind).
FBX container validation covers Kaydara binary/ASCII magic only; deeper FBX structural validation (e.g., fbx-sdk roundtrip) is delegated to J6 roundtrip.
submission/infrastructure/ultimate_pipeline/enrichment/blender_runner.py is a diverged copy (older, no J3 manifest, no provenance) - not updated by this task.
BLENDER_EXE/BLENDER_TIMEOUT_SEC env vars are the only configuration; no settings.py entry exists (aligns with current practice).
